    if "QAP_TIME_LIMIT_S" in os.environ:
        budget = min(budget, float(os.environ["QAP_TIME_LIMIT_S"]))
    start_time = time.time()

    with open(json_path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    n = data["n"]
    A = np.array(data["A"], dtype=int)
    B = np.array(data["B"], dtype=int)

    # Precompute A[i][j] * B[k][l] for all i,j,k,l to avoid repeated indexing
    # But due to memory constraints we compute cost on the fly with vectorized ops
    # using current permutation p

    def cost(p):
        # p is 0-based permutation of length n
        # cost = sum_i sum_j A[i,j] * B[p[i], p[j]]
        # vectorized: for each i, take row A[i] and multiply by B[p[i], p]
        # then sum over i
        pi = p
        # compute B[p[i], p[j]] for all i,j efficiently
        # using advanced indexing
        rows = pi
        cols = pi
        B_sub = B[rows][:, cols]  # shape (n,n)
        return np.sum(A * B_sub)

    # Simulated annealing with 2-opt moves
    best_p = list(range(n))
    best_cost = cost(best_p)
    current_p = best_p[:]
    current_cost = best_cost

    T0 = 1.0
    Tf = 1e-4
    alpha = 0.995  # cooling rate
    max_iter = int(budget * 10)  # roughly 10 iterations per 0.1s

    for it in range(max_iter):
        if time.time() - start_time > budget:
            break
        # Propose a 2-opt move: swap two random positions
        i, j = sorted(random.sample(range(n), 2))
        new_p = current_p[:]
        new_p[i], new_p[j] = new_p[j], new_p[i]
        new_cost = cost(new_p)

        # Acceptance probability
        delta = new_cost - current_cost
        if delta < 0 or random.random() < np.exp(-delta / (T0 * (Tf / T0) ** (it / max_iter))):
            current_p, current_cost = new_p, new_cost
            if new_cost < best_cost:
                best_p, best_cost = new_p[:], new_cost

        T0 *= alpha

    # Output the best permutation found (1-based)
    out = " ".join(str(x + 1) for x in best_p)
    print(f"PERMUTATION: {out}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
